project.domain: Elbrus/E2K architecture research and platform qualification workstream
project.mission: Maintain explicit CPU/SoC identity, ABI, toolchain, linker, image-format, and target-evidence requirements for a possible E2K platform port.

explicit_non_goals: No verified E2K target implementation is claimed
No boot path or physical hardware qualification is claimed
Do not infer E2K properties from another ISA
Host tests cannot substitute for a native E2K runner

safety_boundaries: Keep architecture research separate from implementation claims.
Record source and version for all CPU, ABI, compiler, and platform assumptions.
Do not mark target support verified without native or physical-target evidence appropriate to the claim.
Treat the evidence advisor as a planning aid, not proof of qualification.

native_validation.evidence_note: README documents an evidence advisor; no verified project-wide build/test command or target result is asserted by this profile.
